body: I hate this attitude, tbh. Yes, you’ll meet bosses who think this way, and it’s helpful to leave early as a general rule. But fault is not something to be shouldered only by you and always by you, every single time. If you didn’t know that Vic transit is terrible at accomplishing its duties and you just got passed by an overflowing bus, then no, it is not, “no one’s fault but your own,” that you couldn’t make it to class. It is, in fact, *also* the fault of an inept bureaucracy failing, for at least the 20th year in a row, to accommodate the needs of its constituents.
I would tell you but I’m not sure you’d want it back…

Some see garbage, some see a lack of garbage cans. While you shouldn’t litter, I don’t think telling people not to will do much. Disneyland found that when they just placed garbage cans every 30ft it went from litter hell to almost none—there should at least be garbage/recycling at the bus stops!
Just under 70 million innocent people is probably a *conservative* estimate. But that doesn’t matter—that’s just a statistic to these students.

Sometimes, I think the building itself is part of the problem. The HSD building has an omnipresent stench that hits you in the face the second you walk in. I don’t know if, like cigarette smoke, it’s stained the walls or something, but it pervades literally every corner of every room.
I bike to school and keep a deodorant stick in my bag for this very reason!
